description: Original creative workflow on production infrastructure: turn a script, brief, or idea into a finished talking-head short video, 9:16 for Reels and TikTok unless another aspect ratio is asked for, built one scene at a time and checked after each, following the skills in skills/ (start with skills/creative-video-production.md).

requirements.name: ffmpeg
requirements.purpose: Encoding, mixing, frame extraction and probing (render, gen, add-ons)

requirements.name: playwright-core
requirements.purpose: tools/render/render.js drives a local Chrome to capture the stage

requirements.name: Chromium
requirements.purpose: The browser render.js launches (CHROME_PATH, or Google Chrome)

requirements.name: @spira-lab/cli
requirements.purpose: Model docs only (`spira ai models get`, skills/toolkit.md). Never used to host a file, or to submit, wait on or check a job

requirements.name: spira sign-in
requirements.purpose: The Spira CLI must be signed in as the operator: jobs and host_file run as that account

requirements.name: openai-whisper
requirements.purpose: Word timings for the voice-over (tools/make-timings.py, the assets stage)

requirements.name: yt-dlp
requirements.purpose: Downloading a reference video from a URL

inputs.description: Reference video material, as given by the operator; the agent works out how to use it

stages.title: Preflight, read skills, settle concept and script
Generate voice, talking head, visuals and music; build word timings
Build scenes, animation, captions and sound effects; pass the audit
Render MP4, host it and report
